text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf, too! And T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing them— to every Umamusume in all 
of history!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I will win!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to speed... I won't lose 
either!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Ai
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Go, Ai-chan!! You can win this, you've got 
it!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono is stretching her lead too! Hang 
in there, keep it up!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Will this be a historic moment for Almond 
Eye?! But Chrono Genesis is right there as 
well!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The strongest—is me!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: With everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Ai
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"They're crossing the finish line now!! 
The winner is—"
(Waaaaaaaahhhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! That run was insane! I got 
goosebumps...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ah, it truly was a historic race—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (So this is... how Ai-san runs...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Speed is my weapon. And yet...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan... So you've been honing that 
as well, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Failing to see through that power... Being 
threatened by someone else's speed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To think there were still so many issues 
to address...! How could this be!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll seize a flawless victory!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll aim for a run that can even beat 
Ai-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...I've raced Chrono many times. She got 
stronger with every clash—and now, she's 
even acknowledged by Ai.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I've got my pride as a Grand 
Prix Umamusume too, you know!”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm not letting anyone have the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! ...When it comes to my passion for the 
Grand Prix, I won't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I was able to deliver a run worthy of 
recognition from the great Ai-san herself, 
a living legend who shines brilliantly in 
history.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Leading you to victory is my job.
It's my duty to guide you to victory.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... to the fate that made someone 
like you, who complements my flaws so 
well, my Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
From the bottom of my heart... I am deeply 
grateful...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...The cheers... they won't stop, will 
they? I can feel everyone's excitement.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Running with Ai-san amidst all this fervor 
today... made me feel like I was right at 
the center of a historical drama.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I want to leave my hoofprints right in 
the heart of that cauldron of 
excitement... I want to create a history 
where I am the star...!"
choice_data_list: Let's be the star of the "Arima Kinen"!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will achieve consecutive victories 
in the Spring and Autumn Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I watched today's Tenno Sho (Autumn)! To 
be recognized by that very AI-san— isn't 
that incredible?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next is obviously... the Arima Kinen, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, I'm 
going to the Arima Kinen, too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone in my circle got all 
excited, saying they're gonna cast their 
fan vote for me♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"When you expect that much of me... how 
could I not rise to the occasion?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I intend to repay everyone with 
the greatest love of all—victory!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To be able to leave our hoofprints at the 
Grand Prix with Love-chan... I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen"... As one who strives to 
master the Grand Prix, I will not yield!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just thought... I ought to tell you, 
Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I, too—plan to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"You too, Bouquet-san!? I-If I remember 
right, your next race is—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Having gone through this year's Japan 
Cup, which will undoubtedly go down in 
history...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(This should be an unprecedented 
experience. And that... will become 
Bouquet's strength...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—The most gorgeous, brilliant bouquet of 
flowers. I want to deliver it to someone 
dear to me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a festival, after all. 
It shall serve as a magnificent bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And so—I'm sorry. I will be the one... to 
stop you from winning consecutive Grand 
Prix titles, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I would gladly take you up on that...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...And that... was her declaration of war.
choice_data_list: A showdown with your peers, huh...!
A showdown with your peers, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But I'm happy. To be able to leave 
our hoofprints together with everyone in 
the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan and Bouquet-san will both be 
running in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup and 
Japan Cup, so—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's true that it's hard to get a 
complete read on their strength, but..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... I'm not worried. Because 
you're here with me, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Just like with Ai-san... As long as the 
two of us join forces, there won't be any 
problem, right?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. I'm counting on you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Well then, without further ado... let's 
discuss the training plan...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Toward... back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories at the Arima Kinen!
